recent_dustinc_comments.text: Thank You for chiming in @Chris_AdminBolt, and for being so receptive to the community's feedback! Taking the time to explain things, acknowledge the rough edges, and listen to how people actually use the panel is what will help AdminBolt earn lasting trust. It reminds me of the earlier cPanel days when Nick Koston was at the helm -- that feeling of a product being driven by people with a real passion for hosting. I see that same enthusiasm in what you and Lukasz are doing with AdminBolt - and it's encouraging. Appreciate the work you're putting in! More choice, active development, and a team
